title: OpenZeppelin Ownable owner()
detects: The current owner. The zero address, or a known burn address, means ownership was renounced.
knownFalseNegative: A revert does NOT mean there is no admin. UNI and SHIB both revert on owner() and both have admin power elsewhere. Never treat a revert as 'renounced'. Resolve admin-minter, admin-accesscontrol and proxy-admin-slot before concluding anything.

coversExamples.observed: owner() REVERTS. admin is actually minter(). documented false negative.

rationale: The most common admin shape by volume, and the most commonly misread. Its failure mode is the dangerous direction: it reports a controlled token as renounced.
